_comment: SYNTHETIC — built from the RAML spec, not captured from a live API. Re-capture against production before trusting this suite.
_shape: A 200 response with zero rows and NO isComplete/isCompleted field at all — neither key is present. HotelSearch.parse conservatively reads this as complete=False (see model.py: 'a missing flag means False'), but the CLI must not treat that absence as positive evidence of an unfinished search on the plain (non --complete) path; only an explicit isComplete:false earns exit 5.
